project.oneLine: Normal Minecraft: Java Edition where the only change is ULTRAKILL's movement, mechanics, style and blood-based health, with ULTRAKILL-style explosions that Minecraft reacts to.

melty.loader: fabric (portable Prism Launcher instance, mmc-pack.json names Fabric; see SkyCraft via mashup_info)
melty.note: ULTRAKILL sounds/art are read at runtime from {game:ultrakill}, never copied or shipped.

rows: Short fast burst in look/move direction, brief i-frames
Low fast slide, keeps momentum, shrinks hitbox
Jump off wall, limited count, refilled on ground
Fast drop, impact shockwave on landing
Replaces hearts with a blood bar
Part of damage taken is 'hard' and can only be healed by blood
Damaging/killing mobs makes them bleed; touching blood heals up to the hard-damage limit

explosions.rules: Minecraft must react fully: blocks break per Minecraft rules (drops, tile entities), entities take damage and knockback, items and falling blocks are thrown, fires and TNT chain correctly, no desync.

rows: Replace with blood bar and style meter HUD
Detect parry hit, reflect, apply explosion
Load sounds from ultrakill folder at runtime (companion)

buildNotes: Preflight: every row/column must be filled and every reference resolve before building.
Companion read: ULTRAKILL is Unity; read audio/art from the Unity bundles in {game:ultrakill} at runtime with a Unity asset reader. Nothing from ULTRAKILL is copied into the mod or upload.

Melty steps: game_info on both games, search_mashups, mashup_info skycraft, inspect_package, validate_recipe, one_click_check, create_mod, upload, submit_release, screenshot, test_release, then ask before publish.
